ios.desc:
After a heart-breaking breakup, I looked back and realized I had missed the small signs. If I had reflected on everyday life more actively, I might have noticed what was slowly building. That is why I created Memoiri: a private journal and diary for daily thoughts, moods, memories, and the moments that shape your life.

Memoiri is designed to feel calm, focused, and personal. Write a quick note, save a longer reflection, add photos, record voice memories, sketch an idea, or simply capture how the day felt. Your entries are grouped by day and time, so your story stays easy to browse.

Reflection is built into the experience. Track your mood with simple emojis, revisit past memories, search old entries, and notice patterns across days, weeks, and months.

With Memoiri, you can:

- Write daily journal and diary entries without distraction
- Save memories with text, photos, voice notes, and sketches
- Track mood and emotional patterns over time
- Search entries by words, dates, moods, places, people, and media
- Protect private thoughts with passcode and Face ID support
- Build a gentle journaling habit with Focus Sessions

Memoiri is not about writing perfectly. It is about noticing your life while you are living it.

Download Memoiri and start keeping a meaningful record of your days.
